description: Get one FickelUSA product by id: name, category, image, and how to buy. Most products include buy_url (the fickelusa.com page where the buyer completes the purchase). Screen-printed products use request_quote instead, because the artwork is reviewed. request_quote remains available for custom or large orders (minimum 100 pieces). FICKEL does not take payment.
